_comment: What the installation origin serves, and what is being prepared for it. published_version moves when https://agntnexus.com/connector/connector-release.json serves a new version -- not when a tag, a GitHub release or a merged release tree exists, because none of those is what an installation fetches. reproducible_releases is written by scripts/build_release.py: the commit each release was built from and the SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH it was built with, which is what `scripts/build_release.py reproduce` rebuilds from on every CI run. A newer signed candidate may supersede a pending one the origin never served: the older wheel stays in the tree byte-identical and keeps its reproducible_releases entry, but pending_version moves to the newer one, in the same commit as its signed release (0.8.0 over 0.7.0, agntnexus/agentnexus#79).
